title: 10 Best Horror Films of 2024
excerpt: From folk horror to body horror — the ten films that defined the genre this year.
content: 2024 was horror's best year in a decade. Here's the definitive ranking — one entry per day until we run out of nightmares.
seo_description: From folk horror to body horror, our definitive ranking of the 10 best horror films released in 2024 — with ratings and full breakdowns for each.

items.blurb: Hugh Grant's most unsettling performance in decades — a two-hander that never lets up.
